protocol.purpose: bounded attribution, not matched before/after performance acceptance

limits: Stack observations describe wall time, not CPU usage or a causal assignment of individual slow frames.
The short profiled block includes the first Apps visit. It is not comparable to the earlier warmed, unprofiled matched experiment.
FrameMetrics animation duration can include main-thread frame callbacks; it does not identify one app animator.
Delivered FPS, tab readiness, physical pixels, thermal state and GPU residency were not measured.
The active icon renderer uses cached painterResource; its small unused identity lookup is not established as the source of these stalls.
The rejected native tabs/layer candidate and parked cache, producer-lifecycle and resume-admission experiments were not repeated.
The existing gradual brightness implementation remains deployed; its physical feel is awaiting user feedback.
